claude.rationale: This is a whole-company acquisition: Merger Sub merges into Bankrate with the "pre-existing operating company, not merely selected assets" surviving as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary, so the customer-facing content/audience-aggregation product moves together with the entity's operating processes (gap_45=0 — no product-vs-process split). The existing management is carried forward (subject to change-in-control severance) alongside those processes as the acquired entity itself continues operating, so no process-vs-organization mismatch (gap_56=0). Because Red Ventures enters "as the new controlling parent" and is characterized as "rather than being merged into Bankrate's operations," T1 is coded replace; the whole-company continuity means no divided substrate required a transition-services agreement (gap_mitigated=NA).

grok.rationale: The slice structures a whole-company reverse-subsidiary merger in which Bankrate survives intact as the operating entity and becomes an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Red Ventures, carrying its customer-facing content/audience-aggregation product together with the legal vehicle (T3–T4). Structural summary and interim-arrangement sections state that the product, surviving entity, and existing management move forward together under ordinary-course and access covenants, with no dedicated TSA and no documented product-vs-process or process-vs-organization split at closing; therefore gap_45 and gap_56 are both 0.

openai.rationale: The merger transferred Bankrate as a whole operating company, including its customer-facing content and audience-aggregation product, while Bankrate continued as the surviving corporation and subsidiary; thus the product and its operating processes moved together, supporting gap_45 = 0. The structural summary states that the product, surviving legal entity, and existing management were carried forward together, subject to change-in-control severance arrangements, supporting gap_56 = 0. No divided substrate or dedicated transition-services arrangement was described. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-258576, DEFM14A]
